column1: # The poteto-mode chain, as data. One row per required step. A step with no
# checkable signature is listed under `# unchecked` below rather than given a row
# that always passes, so this file stays the complete list of what the playbooks
# The first non-comment line is the header. The audit resolves columns from it,
# so a new column does not touch the script.
# `scope` is `ship` or `guard`, and nothing else. A `ship` row is checked on the
# call that opens the PR; a `guard` row is checked on the command it is about to
# run, so a CI watch is never judged on the PR body it does not have.
